HP-022.title: No Structure to Dock On: A ChEMBL Potency Analysis of PfATP4 Inhibitors Against Cipargamin, and Why the Best Number Is a 3D7-Only Number
HP-022.abstract: Malaria caused an estimated 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths in 2024, and partial artemisinin resistance is now confirmed or suspected in at least eight African countries, so a drug with a new mechanism is no longer optional. Cipargamin (KAE609), a spiroindolone that inhibits the parasite sodium pump PfATP4, cleared parasites in a median of 8 hours versus 24 hours for artemether-lumefantrine in a phase II trial, but day-28 cure was only just over 65% and the PfATP4 G358S mutation appeared in 65% of treatment failures, so the next PfATP4 drug must beat cipargamin on resistance, not on speed. We ran the LeadForge pipeline (UniProtKB A0A143ZZK9, corrected ChEMBL target CHEMBL6066156, 26 bioactivities across 7 compounds, PubChem verification of cipargamin, RDKit ADMET and PAINS screen) and analysed the four PfATP4 actives with measured potency against cipargamin, with docking deliberately SKIPPED because no X-ray structure of PfATP4 exists. The best record is a dihydroquinazolinone S-enantiomer at EC50 4.6 nM on the 3D7 strain, against cipargamin's literature IC50 of 0.5 to 1.4 nM, but the same compound collapses to 4,100 nM on the Dd2 strain and 7,500 nM on the G358S mutant, while its R-enantiomer holds 18.2, 26.4 and 81.3 nM across the same three assays, and two N-acetamide indoles score 150 and 790 nM with PAINS alerts. The falsifiable next step is a head-to-head Na+-ATPase assay of the two enantiomers plus cipargamin on 3D7, Dd2 and G358S membrane preparations on the same plate: a lead only matters if it keeps potency where the S-enantiomer loses it.
HP-022.keywords: PfATP4; cipargamin; malaria; artemisinin resistance; spiroindolone; ChEMBL; G358S; Plasmodium falciparum

HP-030.title: Midostaurin Out-Docks Gilteritinib by 2.59 kcal/mol and Loses by 8-Fold in Measured Affinity: A Centre-Audited Vina Benchmark of FLT3 Inhibitors on 6JQR
HP-030.abstract: FLT3 internal tandem duplication (FLT3-ITD) occurs in about 25% of acute myeloid leukaemia (AML) and confers poor prognosis with high relapse rates, yet gilteritinib, the FLT3 inhibitor with a proven survival benefit in relapsed or refractory disease, extends median overall survival to only 9.3 months, and gatekeeper (F691L) and activation-loop (D835) mutations erode even that benefit. The gap this paper attacks is whether a standardised docking screen can rank FLT3 inhibitors against gilteritinib at all. We docked gilteritinib, four established FLT3 inhibitors and seven PubChem analogues on the 2.20 Å gilteritinib-bound FLT3 kinase-domain structure 6JQR (AutoDock Vina 1.2.7, grid centred on the co-crystallised ligand centroid), after the ChEMBL activity endpoint returned HTTP 500 and the pipeline retrieved no ligands. Midostaurin scored best (−10.42 kcal/mol) and crenolanib second (−9.55), ahead of gilteritinib (−7.83) and quizartinib (−7.70), but against single-assay measured Kd values the ranking is uncorrelated (Spearman ρ = −0.3, p = 0.62, n = 5): midostaurin, the best by Vina, is the weakest measured binder (Kd 7.9 nM), while crenolanib, the strongest measured binder (Kd 0.28 nM), ranks second. Among the three type I inhibitors the reversal is exact (ρ = −1.0), so the failure is not a type I versus type II artefact. One PAINS-clean analogue (PubChem CID 150967523, −8.91 kcal/mol) out-scored gilteritinib by 1.08 kcal/mol, inside the ±1–2 kcal/mol Vina noise, and gilteritinib itself carries a PAINS alert, so neither is a lead claim. The falsifiable next step is a single-assay FLT3 kinase panel of the five inhibitors plus the three best analogues, with F691L and D835Y mutant arms: if the measured order follows the published Kd order rather than the Vina order, rigid docking must not be used to prioritise FLT3 leads on this structure.
HP-030.keywords: FLT3; gilteritinib; acute myeloid leukaemia; FLT3-ITD; molecular docking; AutoDock Vina; F691L; drug resistance

HP-016.title: Vina Ranks the Proven Inhibitor Last: A Centre-Audited Benchmark of 6-Methylidene Penem Inhibitors Against Enterobacter cloacae AmpC on 1RGZ Versus the Hydrolysed Substrate Ceftazidime
HP-016.abstract: Third-generation cephalosporin-resistant Enterobacterales are a critical-priority pathogen on the WHO 2024 Bacterial Priority Pathogens List, and their inducible chromosomal AmpC beta-lactamase hydrolyses ceftazidime and related cephalosporins, so resistance can emerge during treatment itself. The gap this paper attacks is whether standardised docking can rank AmpC inhibitors at all, given that the reference drug is a substrate, not an inhibitor. We ran the LeadForge pipeline (UniProtKB P05364 to ChEMBL CHEMBL2725, 732 bioactivities, to RDKit ADMET and PAINS screening, to AutoDock Vina 1.2.7) and docked the five most potent ChEMBL AmpC actives, 6-methylidene penems with measured IC50 values of 1 to 2 nM, plus ceftazidime and the clinically proven covalent inhibitor avibactam, into the 1.37 angstrom Enterobacter cloacae GC1 AmpC structure 1RGZ, with the grid centre exactly on the co-crystallised transition-state analogue (0.00 angstrom). Two penems out-scored ceftazidime (CHEMBL222758 minus 8.99 and CHEMBL222375 minus 8.86 versus ceftazidime minus 8.20 kcal/mol), but both margins sit inside the plus-minus 1 to 2 kcal/mol Vina noise, and the rank correlation with measured potency is weak (Spearman rho plus 0.38, n equals 5). The decisive result is avibactam: the only clinically validated AmpC inhibitor in the set scored weakest of all (minus 5.82 kcal/mol), below even the hydrolysed substrate, because its potency comes from reversible covalent carbamylation of Ser64, which non-covalent docking cannot score. The falsifiable next step is a nitrocefin hydrolysis assay of the five penems with avibactam as control: if the measured IC50 order follows the ChEMBL record rather than the Vina order, rigid docking must not be used to prioritise AmpC inhibitors.
HP-016.keywords: AmpC beta-lactamase; Enterobacter cloacae; ceftazidime; avibactam; molecular docking; AutoDock Vina; 6-methylidene penem; cephalosporin resistance

HP-002.title: The Best Docking Score Is the Weakest Measured Binder: A Centre-Audited PPAR-gamma Screen Against Pioglitazone on 9F7W, with a Corrected ChEMBL Target
HP-002.abstract: Type 2 diabetes affects 589 million adults worldwide, and Pakistan carries the world's highest age-standardised prevalence at 31.4%, yet the most effective insulin sensitiser, pioglitazone, is limited by PPAR-gamma-driven weight gain of about 3.5 kg over six months and oedema in about 5% of patients. The gap this paper attacks is whether a standardised docking screen can rank partial-agonist candidates against pioglitazone at all, and whether thymoquinone, a natural product with reported PPAR-gamma activity, binds the receptor at all. We ran the LeadForge pipeline (UniProtKB P37231 → ChEMBL → PubChem → RDKit ADMET/PAINS → AutoDock Vina 1.2.7) and docked four ChEMBL PPAR-gamma actives, pioglitazone and thymoquinone into the 1.25 Å PPAR-gamma ligand-binding-domain structure 9F7W, with the grid centre audited to 0.01 Å from the co-crystallised ligand. The first pipeline run silently retrieved maltase-glucoamylase actives instead of PPAR-gamma actives; the audit caught it, and the run was repeated against the verified target CHEMBL235. One lead out-scored pioglitazone — CHEMBL6145236 at −10.24 versus −9.00 kcal/mol — but the margin (1.24 kcal/mol) sits at the edge of the ±1–2 kcal/mol Vina noise, and the ranking is reversed against measured potency: Spearman ρ = −0.8 (n = 4), with the strongest measured binder (CHEMBL1813011, EC50 0.018 nM) ranking third by Vina. Thymoquinone docked weakly (−6.25 kcal/mol) and carries a PAINS quinone alert. The falsifiable next step is a PPAR-gamma transactivation assay of the four leads against pioglitazone: if the measured EC50 order matches the ChEMBL record rather than the Vina order, docking alone must not be used to prioritise PPAR-gamma leads on this structure.
HP-002.keywords: PPAR-gamma; pioglitazone; partial agonist; molecular docking; AutoDock Vina; type 2 diabetes; thymoquinone; SPPARM

HP-041.title: No Approved Dengue Drug, No Docking Winner: NSC135618 and ARDP0006 Are Indistinguishable by Vina on the DENV NS2B–NS3 Protease Allosteric and Active-Site Structures
HP-041.abstract: Dengue infected a record 14.6 million people reported to the World Health Organization in 2024, with more than 12,000 deaths, and there is still no approved antiviral drug: care is supportive only, and the single WHO-prequalified vaccine is licensed for narrow age groups in high-transmission settings. The viral NS2B-NS3 protease is the most studied dengue drug target, yet its two best-characterised published inhibitors were measured in assays that cannot be compared head-to-head: the allosteric inhibitor NSC135618 inhibits the DENV-2 protease with an IC50 of 1.8 micromolar, while the anthraquinone ARDP0006 was reported by cell-based titre reduction of more than 1 log PFU per millilitre at 1 micromolar. We asked whether standardised docking can rank them. The LeadForge pipeline (UniProtKB P29990, PubChem verification, RDKit ADMET and PAINS screen, AutoDock Vina 1.2.7) returned no ChEMBL lead set for this target, and its automatic structure pick was an NS1 complex, not the protease, so that score was discarded. We re-docked both inhibitors on two verified protease structures with grid centres exactly on the co-crystallised ligands: the allosteric structure 6MO2 (2.8 angstrom) and the closed active-site structure 3U1I (2.3 angstrom). On 6MO2, ARDP0006 scored minus 7.40 and NSC135618 minus 7.21 kilocalories per mole; on 3U1I, NSC135618 scored minus 6.84 and ARDP0006 minus 6.27. Every margin is under 1 kilocalorie per mole, inside Vina's plus-minus 1 to 2 kilocalorie per mole noise, and NSC135618 carries a PAINS alert from its azo group, so neither compound can be called better than the other by docking. The falsifiable next step is a single head-to-head DENV-2 protease inhibition assay for both compounds on the same plate, with redox and aggregation controls for the azo scaffold: if NSC135618's measured IC50 does not reproduce under those controls, its published potency is an artefact, not a lead.
HP-041.keywords: dengue virus; NS2B-NS3 protease; NSC135618; ARDP0006; molecular docking; AutoDock Vina; allosteric inhibitor; flavivirus
